hypotheses.quality: The 24-skill MRR/Recall ceiling will weaken as the candidate pool grows; measure each method's ranking degradation rather than claiming parity from the local ceiling.
hypotheses.cost: BM25, the official 0.6B encoder, and strict top-20 reranking have materially different preparation, indexing, memory, and online-query scaling curves.

scale_slices.local_24_skill_result_role: context-only reference from published_baselines_v02; not a point on the official-dataset scaling curve
scale_slices.construction: For each tier include every graded relevance ID for the 75 core tasks, then fill distractors in ascending SHA-256(seed|tier|skill_id) order. Index order is required IDs followed by distractors, while score ties use the same relevance-blind SHA-256 key.
